16257.note: The buff the sim applies at every rank (3 swings, 15 sec); its own 10% is a placeholder and the attack speed comes from the beta client's talent curve, 5/10/15/20/25% (Classic: 10% to 30%). The other ranks' buff ids are gone from the client. Beta log 2701 (foreverlogs.gg, 2026-10-02) bears this out: swings under the buff ran 15% faster for two 19-point Enhancement shamans (Tide, Lietus: 102 swings in 25 fights) and 10% for an 18-point one (Thundrax: 33 in 10), the most points each total allows next to Stormstrike, so the server grants a per-point amount, not the buff's flat 10%.

16344.note: Rank 6's proc, the only one the sim casts. Beta client 1.60.1.70009: 16344 stores 2810 at level 60, hundredths of Fire damage per second of weapon speed, speed held to 1.3-4.0 as the Forever tooltip's (X / 77 - 1) to (X / 25) reads, so 35 to 112 a hit; the damage lands as Flametongue Attack (29469) at the client's 0.1 coefficient; the beta enchant (1666) lasts 1 hour. The TBC sim's flat 35 a second is gone. A beta log bears out the scale at rank 1 (4.4 a second): 100 hits from a 2.5 speed weapon with no spell power averaged 11.2 against 11 (foreverlogs.gg report 2671).
16344.tooltip: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes 35 to 112 additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. Lasts 1 hour.

16387.note: Rank 4, the only rank the sim casts. Beta client 1.60.1.70205: 275 mana, 1 sec global, 5 min; its party aura (15036) procs on every landed melee auto and triggers 16389, 1363 hundredths of Fire damage per second of main-hand speed (1.3-4.0), the imbue's shape. The hit lands as Flametongue Attack 16368, whose client row has no spell power coefficient and a class mask Elemental Fury and Elemental Weapons don't name. A beta log bears it out at rank 1 (8253, 5.48 a second): 5 players' totem hits average 13.0-20.6 against 13.2-20.8 for their 2.4-3.8 speed main hands, crits 1.5x, one hit for every landed main-hand swing while the totem was up (735 of 738), none from a rogue's off hand, Sinister Strike, Holy Strike, Stormstrike or Windfury Weapon's extra hits (foreverlogs.gg report 2713). It doesn't stack with Windfury Totem or a main-hand Flametongue Weapon (beta development notes, tooltips 8024/16342). Ported from MythicSim patch 70.
assumptions: Windfury Totem wins when both totems are down: the development notes say they no longer stack, not which one stays.

408505.note: The stacking buff (408505, 30 sec, 5 stacks) and -4/-8/-12/-16/-20% per stack (408498's curve) are the beta client's. The client states no proc rate; the beta's combat log gives it. Steele (foreverlogs.gg report 2748, 26 Enhancement points so 1 in the talent; their Lightning Bolt casts 4% faster per stack) gains a stack on 0.54 of 335 lone landed auto attacks and Stormstrikes with a 3.6 sec two-hander and Windfury Weapon: 9 procs a minute (8 to 10), never on a miss. SoD's +50% for Windfury Weapon and +50% for a two-hander (408498's eff1 50) would have procced every hit; Forever drops them. 439440.note: Beta client 1.60.1.70205: every rank's enchant (283/284/525/1669) equips 439431, a dummy aura that rolls 20% on landed melee autos and abilities (ProcTypeMask 20) with a 1.5 sec ProcCategoryRecovery; it triggers nothing in the client, so the server scripts the attack. Beta log 2708 (foreverlogs.gg, 2026-10-03, Toma, 22 Enhancement, level 30, Corpsemaker 3.8 speed) shows what it does: all 62 procs (46 off autos, 16 off Stormstrike) are two hits of this spell, a SPELL_EFFECT_WEAPON_DAMAGE special attack, in the same instant as the hit that procced them; they miss, dodge and parry on their own (20 of 121) and their crits proc Flurry. The next auto still lands one weapon speed after the last one (0.2 to 3 sec after a Stormstrike proc), so the swing timer is untouched, and no 16361 buff is ever applied, so there is no third, lifted swing. The sim strikes twice with the proc's weapon (439441, Attributes[3] 0x1000000, for the off hand) and adds the rank's attack power to them, 333 at 60 (16361; Wowhead's 433 is its level 68 print). At level 30 the strikes averaged 9% above Stormstrike's on the same mobs, about 67 attack power; rank 1's 46 fits within the log's unknown buffs.
